changes: Drove packages/*/src to literal zero koala: renamed all 8 koala-* signature salts to lattice-* (review/finding/scope/run integrity + story-store; globally consistent across signers/verifiers incl. 4 verify-*.mjs script fixtures), deleted the legacy-koala detection (bin/koala*.js denylist, @koala-agent old-install handling, isKoalaSelfRepoBootstrap->isLatticeSelfRepoBootstrap), renamed config (idleKoala->idleLattice, koala.config.json->lattice.config.json) + .koala/ runtime paths (->.lattice) + 4 koala.* schema ids, and renamed+flipped the residue gate (verify-koala-residue.mjs->verify-lattice-residue.mjs, KOALA_RESIDUE_*->LATTICE_RESIDUE_*) to zero-tolerance over packages/*/src.
usage: No new user command — a ship-clean rename refactor. The residue gate is now 'lattice-residue' (npm run test:lattice-residue) and FAILS on any koala in packages/*/src. In-flight stories signed with the old koala salt must re-run init-check/review/delivery; old koala config/storage is not migrated.
expectedOutcome: git grep -i koala -- packages/*/src returns ZERO; node scripts/verify-lattice-residue.mjs PASS; tsc clean.
actualTranscript: git grep koala packages/*/src = 0 hits (exit 1); verify-lattice-residue PASS 0 residue + self-test 7/7; tsc exit 0; validate PASS; 58/58 intents fresh; round-2 review 3 lanes PASS.
outcomeDiff: No difference — expected and actual match.
limitations: Scoped to packages/*/src product code. Remaining koala lives only in the gate SCANNER (must contain the literal to detect it), test fixtures (packages/main/tests/fixtures), and docs/experiments (gate does not scan docs; a later docs story). The salt rename breaks in-flight stories' old-salt signatures (user-accepted).
pitfalls: Premise corrected TWICE: koala-<role> were legacy-DETECTION literals + salts, not lane tokens (first re-scope discarded B-ac07). Literal-zero requires deleting legacy-koala cleanup (you can't clean old koala without naming it) + renaming the gate itself. Salt rename must be globally consistent (4 verify scripts + fixtures, else latent verifier mismatch). Finding-fixes drift storyFilesHash -> stale review-run bindings forced a DEV->REVIEW round restart + recover_evidence re-stamp; codex-adapter gate needed 'lattice codex verify'. Degraded 3x1 floor: bind all 4 fields (materialDigest+storyFilesHash+validationDigest+promptDigest).
